verdict.rationale: The evidence shows the Search API returns ranked results with domain, language, and region filters, but nothing says each result carries a numeric relevance score a developer could threshold on. Ranking order is not a per-result score. The calibrated probabilities feature covers yes/no, multiple-choice, and rubric questions, not search results, so it is a different feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can read per-result relevance scores to threshold what enters my pipeline
